options.title: Max line length
options.summary: Maximum line length in columns (40 or more). Long lines are wrapped when "Reflow lines" is on.

options.title: Indent step
options.summary: Indentation step in spaces, 0 to 16 (each nesting level adds this many).

options.title: Tab width
options.summary: Width assumed for an existing tab on input, 1 to 16. YADF always emits spaces.

options.title: Break if/then/else body onto its own line
options.summary: On: the then/else bodies of an if go on their own indented lines. Off: the whole if ("if C then A else B;") goes on one line when it fits the max length, else every body on its own line.

options.title: Break loop body onto its own line
options.summary: On: the body of a for/while loop goes on its own indented line. Off: a short simple body is joined onto the do line when it fits the max length.

options.title: Break with body onto its own line
options.summary: On: the body of a with..do goes on its own indented line. Off: a short simple body is joined onto the do line when it fits the max length.

options.title: Put begin on the same line as then / do / else
options.summary: On: begin joins the line of its then / do / else, case label or case else ("if C then begin", "end else begin", "9: begin"). Off: begin goes on its own line, and "end" / "else" / "begin" on three lines. A block that "Fold short begin..end onto one line" folds onto one line is not affected. Off by default.

options.title: Fold short begin..end onto one line
options.summary: Fold a short begin..end body of if/for/while/with, a case arm or the case else onto one line when it fits; off = expand such one-line blocks. Off by default.

options.title: Pack several statements on one line
options.summary: On: adjacent plain statements ("A:= 1; B:= 2;") are packed onto one line while it fits the max length. Off: one statement per line. Block keywords (begin, repeat, try, case, record, class) always start a line either way. Off by default.

options.title: Pack short bodies & case arms (retired)
options.summary: Retired in 1.0.21.0. PackShortBodies = true in an INI is still read: it turns the three Break ... body options off and Case arm on its label line on.

options.title: One-statement case arm on its label line
options.summary: Put a case arm whose body is one short simple statement on its label line ("0: DoZero;"), the case else part included ("else DoOther;"); off = the statement goes on its own line under the label.

options.title: Break case labels one per line
options.summary: Break a multi-label case arm ("a, b, c: Stmt;") into one label per line. Off by default.

options.title: Reflow lines (join and wrap)
options.summary: Join a statement broken by hand when it fits the max line length and wrap longer lines. Off = the author's line breaks are kept and long lines are left as-is.

options.title: Long expressions: one part per line
options.summary: A statement over the max length gets one component per line, the operator or comma leading; a long bracketed list becomes a tree, one whole branch per line. Off = greedy packing, comma-last.

options.title: Join routine headers split by hand
options.summary: Join a routine header the author split across lines back onto one line, wrapping it at the max length. Off = one parameter per line instead (implies "Break parameters one per line"). On by default.

options.title: Break parameters one per line
options.summary: Lay out routine declarations with 2+ parameters one parameter per line. Off by default; always on while "Join routine headers split by hand" is off. The separator side follows "Put the separator last in broken lists".

options.title: Split "A, B: T" into one per name
options.summary: Split "I, J: integer;" into one line per name so the type colons align. Off = kept as written.

options.title: Break uses clauses, one unit per line
options.summary: Always break uses clauses one unit per line.

options.title: Put the separator last in broken lists
options.summary: Separator side in a broken uses clause or parameter list: off = separator first (", Unit", diff-friendly), on = separator last ("Unit,").

options.title: No space before :=
options.summary: No space BEFORE := ("X:= 1" not "X := 1"). Off = kept as written.

options.title: Space after :=
options.summary: Single space AFTER := ("X:= 1" not "X:=1"). Off = kept as written.

options.title: Space around operators
options.summary: One space around binary operators (A+B -> A + B). Unary signs and generic brackets are left alone. Off = kept as written.

options.title: Trim trailing spaces
options.summary: Trim trailing whitespace from every output line.

options.title: Max blank lines
options.summary: Maximum consecutive blank lines kept in output. Excess blanks are collapsed.

options.title: Blanks before section
options.summary: Blank lines forced before each interface section. 0 = no change.

options.title: Blanks before method
options.summary: Blank lines forced before each method body.

options.title: Blanks before type
options.summary: Blank lines forced before each top-level type declaration.

options.title: Align := runs (master switch for shapes)
options.summary: Master switch for shape-aware alignment of := runs and, with "Align lines of the same shape", other matching shapes.

options.title: Align = in const blocks
options.summary: Vertical-align = in const blocks.

options.title: Align : in declarations
options.summary: Vertical-align : in type / var / parameter blocks.

options.title: Align ; at the end of declarations
options.summary: Align the trailing ; of consecutive declaration lines (after "Align : in declarations").

options.title: Align lines of the same shape
options.summary: Align matching "shapes" (record-init lines, repeated field declarations).

options.title: Align max column
options.summary: Maximum column an alignment may push to. Past this, alignment is skipped.

options.title: Shape min anchors
options.summary: Minimum anchors required before shape-alignment kicks in.

options.title: Comment max shift
options.summary: Maximum columns a trailing comment may shift when aligning to a shape.

options.title: Lowercase keywords
options.summary: Lowercase Pascal keywords (begin, end, if, then ...).

options.title: Uppercase hex
options.summary: Uppercase hex digits and the exponent letter in numeric literals ($AB not $ab, 1E5 not 1e5).

options.title: Uppercase directives
options.summary: Uppercase compiler-directive keywords ({$IFDEF}, {$R+} ...).

options.title: First-occurrence casing
options.summary: Cascade casing from the first occurrence of each identifier to all later uses.

options.title: Re-indent comment lines with the code
options.summary: Re-indent comment-only lines to the surrounding code depth. A "//." comment keeps its indentation.

options.title: Label the end of long blocks
options.summary: Mark the end of long blocks with the block keyword: "end; // while". On also removes such a label from a block that is no longer long; off = existing labels are kept as written. An asm block is never labelled.

options.title: Label min lines
options.summary: Minimum block length in lines (1 or more) before a long block gets an end label.

options.title: Mark unclosed blocks
options.summary: Add a "// TODO -oYADF" marker where a begin/record/... has no matching end.

options.title: Hoist inline vars (Delphi 10.2.3)
options.summary: Hoist inline var declarations into a var block so the code builds on Delphi 10.2.3. Best-effort: every comment it adds (an inferred type to verify, a var it could not hoist) starts "// TODO -oYADF -cd10 :", and a run with this option off removes exactly those comments.

options.title: Backup before overwrite
options.summary: Create a backup of every file before overwriting it, and of an edited preview sample (Sample.pas.bak) before a newer YADF replaces it.

options.title: Backup directory
options.summary: Directory for backups (used when backup is on). Empty = next to the original file.

options.title: Result directory
options.summary: Directory for formatted output. Empty = format in place.

options.title: Output encoding
options.summary: ANSI keeps each file's own encoding; UTF-8/UTF-16 convert the output (with BOM).

options.title: Logging
options.summary: Write a log file with details of every option resolved and file processed.

options.title: Profiles (F and R)
options.summary: Named settings files. F = Ctrl+Shift+Alt+F, R = Ctrl+Shift+Alt+R; assign a profile to a key with Set F / Set R.

options.title: Rules (always on)
options.summary: Layout rules YADF applies whatever the settings, the options whose "off" keeps the source as written, and the options that depend on each other.

options.title: Use YADF as the IDE code formatter
options.summary: Use YADF for Format Source and format-on-save (Delphi 13.2+, F profile). Needs an IDE restart.
